items.statement: Within the stated isolated-molecule and method-dependent scope, the calculation supports the paper's conclusion of good IR and UV-visible agreement.
items.expected: The report gives a supported agreement assessment while distinguishing computed from experimental quantities.

items.statement: The electronic-transition evidence is used to assess, with appropriate caution, the reported intramolecular charge-transfer interpretation.
items.expected: Orbital/transition evidence is discussed and the qualitative interpretation is bounded rather than presented as a measured charge-transfer value.
